archived.reason: Documentation for one Universe-operated Dogecoin TAP indexer, superseded by maintained protocol documentation. TAP on Dogecoin is now documented at bitcoinuniverseio/tap-on-doge, the portal publishes Universe support at /protocols/tap_doge/, and the Dogecoin ordinals implementation is documented in bitcoinuniverseio/ord-dogecoin. The final API contract and README are preserved here.
